# Commands

<!-- Generated by `coney-tools refs render` from research/references/commands.yaml. Do not edit. -->

The commands a human acts on. A **pad command** is a number the matcher makes from a player's
buttons each update, through the nine **trigger** kinds; `global.lua` binds them with
`AddCommand(command, trigger, buttons, extra)` and scripts switch them per human with `EnableCommand`.
AI humans write the same numbers. A **Warrior command** is an order the war chief gives the crew from
the command menu (`WCIssueCommand`, `WCEnableCommand`). How buttons are matched:
[Combat: commands](../research/combat.md#commands); the orders:
[AI: Warrior commands](../research/ai.md#warrior-commands); the buttons: [Controls](controls.md).

!!! info "What is complete"

    Every trigger kind, every pad command the scripts bind or switch and all seven Warrior commands
    are listed. What 1, 2, 9, 11, 21, 22 and 37-44 do is not traced, nor the command menu's layout; pad
    commands the code tests but no script binds are not listed.

50 entries. Data: `research/references/commands.yaml`.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Hand-written | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | str | | Our stable id: `trigger:<n>`, `pad:<n>` or `warrior:<n>`. |
| `kind` | str | | Trigger kind, pad command or Warrior command. |
| `number` | int | | The number scripts pass: `AddCommand`'s trigger, its command id (1-57), or the Warrior command (`WCIssueCommand`, 0-6). |
| `hex` | hex | | A pad command's id in hex, as the research pages write it. |
| `name` | str | yes | Our short name for it. |
| `bound` | list | | How the scripts bind a pad command: `trigger: buttons`. |
| `action` | str | yes | What it does. |
| `speech` | str | yes | The speech command a war chief says when giving a Warrior command. |
| `bound_in` | list | | The scripts that bind it. |
| `toggled_in` | list | | The scripts that switch a pad command per human (`EnableCommand`). |
| `used_in` | list | | The scripts that enable, disable or issue a Warrior command. |
| `source` | str | yes | Where the entry comes from: a script and binding, an address, a chunk. |
| `evidence` | str | yes | How we know: confirmed-code, confirmed-runtime, inferred or speculative ([evidence levels](../guides/research-workflow.md#evidence-levels)). |
| `notes` | str | yes | Our own short notes. |
